none: PAS NLM-B0E466: Roman Coin: Radiate of Victorinus
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Radiate, either an irregular copy for Victorinus (269-271) or a barbarous radiate (275-285); the former preferred; Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate bust cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [---]C VICT[---]VS [AVG], the C is reversed. Reverse description: Stickman standing left with right arm raised. Reverse inscription: AV[G] blundered. Diameter: 15.7mm, Weight:…
